tbesh_html:
: saint/priest
sacred, holy, Holy One, saint, set apart
A sub-meaning of qa.dosh (קָדוֹשׁ ": holy" H6918)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary

occurrences.bsb: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

occurrences.bsb: Aaron and his sons are to eat the remainder. It must be eaten without leaven in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.
occurrences.kjv: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

occurrences.bsb: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it must be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.
occurrences.kjv: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

occurrences.bsb: Anything that touches its flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in a holy place.
occurrences.kjv: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

occurrences.bsb: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
occurrences.kjv: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

occurrences.bsb: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the food offerings to the LORD; for this is what I have been commanded.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the Lord made by fire: for so I am commanded.

occurrences.bsb: For I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am holy. You must not defile yourselves by any creature that crawls along the ground.
occurrences.kjv: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

occurrences.bsb: For I am the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.
occurrences.kjv: For I am the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

occurrences.bsb: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes. Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people.
occurrences.kjv: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

occurrences.bsb: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
occurrences.kjv: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.

occurrences.bsb: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
occurrences.kjv: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God.

occurrences.bsb: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

occurrences.bsb: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the food offerings, the food of their God, they must be holy.
occurrences.kjv: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

occurrences.bsb: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
occurrences.kjv: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

occurrences.bsb: You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy—I who set you apart.
occurrences.kjv: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the Lord, which sanctify you, am holy.

occurrences.bsb: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place; for it is to him a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD—his portion forever.”
occurrences.kjv: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.

occurrences.bsb: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar and put some of the dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.
occurrences.kjv: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

occurrences.bsb: For the entire period of his vow of separation, no razor shall touch his head. He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete; he must let the hair of his head grow long.
occurrences.kjv: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

occurrences.bsb: Throughout the time of his separation, he is holy to the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Then you will remember and obey all My commandments, and you will be holy to your God.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

occurrences.bsb: They came together against Moses and Aaron and told them, “You have taken too much upon yourselves! For everyone in the entire congregation is holy, and the LORD is in their midst. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?”
occurrences.kjv: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?

occurrences.bsb: Then he said to Korah and all his followers, “Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring that person near to Himself. The one He chooses He will bring near to Himself.
occurrences.kjv: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

occurrences.bsb: and tomorrow you are to place fire and incense in them in the presence of the LORD. Then the man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy. It is you sons of Levi who have taken too much upon yourselves!”
occurrences.kjv: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

occurrences.bsb: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all the peoples on the face of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God, and the Lord hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

occurrences.bsb: You are not to eat any carcass; you may give it to the foreigner residing within your gates, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. For you are a holy people belonging to the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
occurrences.kjv: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

occurrences.bsb: For the LORD your God walks throughout your camp to protect you and deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, lest He see anything unclean among you and turn away from you.
occurrences.kjv: For the Lord thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.

occurrences.bsb: that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, as He has promised.
occurrences.kjv: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the Lord thy God, as he hath spoken.

occurrences.bsb: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and walk in his ways.

occurrences.bsb: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words—
occurrences.kjv: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

occurrences.bsb: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.
occurrences.kjv: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the Lord: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

occurrences.bsb: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
occurrences.kjv: There is none holy as the Lord: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

occurrences.bsb: The men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?”
occurrences.kjv: And the men of Beth–shemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy Lord God? and to whom shall he go up from us?

occurrences.bsb: Then the woman said to her husband, “Behold, now I know that the one who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
occurrences.kjv: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

occurrences.bsb: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
occurrences.kjv: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: To the Levites who taught all Israel and were holy to the LORD, Josiah said: “Put the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel. It is not to be carried around on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and His people Israel.
occurrences.kjv: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the Lord, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the Lord your God, and his people Israel,

occurrences.bsb: Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to all of them, “This day is holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep.” For all the people were weeping as they heard the words of the Law.
occurrences.kjv: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

occurrences.bsb: Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
occurrences.kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

occurrences.bsb: And the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Be still, since today is holy. Do not grieve.”
occurrences.kjv: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.

occurrences.bsb: “Call out if you please, but who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
occurrences.kjv: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

occurrences.bsb: It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
occurrences.kjv: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

occurrences.bsb: If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
occurrences.kjv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

occurrences.bsb: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
occurrences.kjv: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

occurrences.bsb: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
occurrences.kjv: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

occurrences.bsb: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
occurrences.kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

occurrences.bsb: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD—Your faithfulness as well—in the assembly of the holy ones.
occurrences.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

occurrences.bsb: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
occurrences.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

occurrences.bsb: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

occurrences.bsb: Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy!
occurrences.kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

occurrences.bsb: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
occurrences.kjv: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

occurrences.bsb: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
occurrences.kjv: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

occurrences.bsb: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
occurrences.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

occurrences.bsb: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
occurrences.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

occurrences.bsb: I have not learned wisdom, and I have no knowledge of the Holy One.
occurrences.kjv: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

occurrences.bsb: Then too, I saw the burial of the wicked who used to go in and out of the holy place, and they were praised in the city where they had done so. This too is futile.
occurrences.kjv: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.

occurrences.bsb: Alas, O sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a brood of evildoers, children who act corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD; they have despised the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on Him.
occurrences.kjv: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever remains in Zion and whoever is left in Jerusalem will be called holy—all in Jerusalem who are recorded among the living—
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

occurrences.bsb: But the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice, and the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

occurrences.bsb: to those who say, “Let Him hurry and hasten His work so that we may see it! Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come so that we may know it!”
occurrences.kjv: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes the straw, and as dry grass shrivels in the flame, so their roots will decay and their blossoms will blow away like dust; for they have rejected the instruction of the LORD of Hosts and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
occurrences.kjv: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

occurrences.bsb: And the Light of Israel will become a fire, and its Holy One a flame. In a single day it will burn and devour Assyria’s thorns and thistles.
occurrences.kjv: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

occurrences.bsb: On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer depend on him who struck them, but they will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

occurrences.bsb: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
occurrences.kjv: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

occurrences.bsb: In that day men will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: The humble will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: The meek also shall increase their joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: For when he sees his children around him, the work of My hands, they will honor My name, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Get out of the way; turn off the road. Rid us of the Holy One of Israel!”
occurrences.kjv: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence—but you were not willing.”
occurrences.kjv: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!

occurrences.bsb: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
occurrences.kjv: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: “To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
occurrences.kjv: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

occurrences.bsb: Do not fear, O Jacob, you worm, O few men of Israel. I will help you,” declares the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: You will winnow them, and a wind will carry them away; a gale will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the LORD; you will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.”
occurrences.kjv: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

occurrences.bsb: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
occurrences.kjv: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

occurrences.bsb: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
occurrences.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

occurrences.bsb: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”
occurrences.kjv: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

occurrences.bsb: Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: “Concerning things to come, do you question Me about My sons, or instruct Me in the work of My hands?
occurrences.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

occurrences.bsb: Our Redeemer—the LORD of Hosts is His name—is the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.
occurrences.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

occurrences.bsb: Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the Servant of rulers: “Kings will see You and rise, and princes will bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You.”
occurrences.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

occurrences.bsb: For your husband is your Maker—the LORD of Hosts is His name—the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
occurrences.kjv: For thy Maker is thine husband; the Lord of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

occurrences.bsb: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
occurrences.kjv: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the Lord thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

occurrences.bsb: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
occurrences.kjv: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

occurrences.bsb: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
occurrences.kjv: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:

occurrences.bsb: Surely the islands will wait for Me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
occurrences.kjv: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

occurrences.bsb: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Summon the archers against Babylon, all who string the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: For Israel and Judah have not been abandoned by their God, the LORD of Hosts, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.”
occurrences.kjv: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: So I will make My holy name known among My people Israel and will no longer allow it to be profaned. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
occurrences.kjv: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.

occurrences.bsb: Then the man said to me, “The north and south chambers facing the temple courtyard are the holy chambers where the priests who approach the LORD will eat the most holy offerings. There they will place the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.
occurrences.kjv: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the Lord shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

occurrences.bsb: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, “How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled?”
occurrences.kjv: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

occurrences.bsb: His power will be great, but it will not be his own. He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people.
occurrences.kjv: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

occurrences.bsb: I will not execute the full fury of My anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God and not man—the Holy One among you—and I will not come in wrath.
occurrences.kjv: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.

occurrences.bsb: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
occurrences.kjv: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.

occurrences.bsb: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
occurrences.kjv: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

occurrences.bsb: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
occurrences.kjv: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

occurrences.bsb: You will flee by My mountain valley, for it will extend to Azal. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
